fusions.name: Inscribed Charge
fusions.desc: Writes a raw glyph into the target with a strike that deals 28 damage, ignores resistances and leaves it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Glyph Line
fusions.desc: Writes a 6-tile line of burning glyphs ahead of you for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Read the Scroll
fusions.desc: Reads a scroll aloud and restores 20 mana.

fusions.name: Candlelit Study
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.
